verse.speaker: Sanjaya
verse.devanagari: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत । सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः ॥ २-१०॥
verse.iast: tamuvāca hṛṣīkeśaḥ prahasanniva bhārata | senayorubhayormadhye viṣīdantamidaṃ vacaḥ

state.translation: Then, O Bharata, between the two armies, Hrishikesha, as if smiling, spoke these words to the one sinking in despair.

show: Then, O Bharata, between the two armies, Hrishikesha, as if smiling, spoke these words to the one sinking in despair.

verse.speaker: Sanjaya
verse.devanagari: एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः सङ्ख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् । विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः ॥ १-४७॥
verse.iast: evamuktvārjunaḥ saṅkhye rathopastha upāviśat | visṛjya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ śokasaṃvignamānasaḥ

state.translation: Having spoken thus on the battlefield, Arjuna sank down on the seat of the chariot, casting aside his bow and arrows, his mind overwhelmed by grief.

show: Having spoken thus on the battlefield, Arjuna sank down on the seat of the chariot, casting aside his bow and arrows, his mind overwhelmed by grief.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन । मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥ २-४७॥
verse.iast: karmaṇyevādhikāraste mā phaleṣu kadācana | mā karmaphalaheturbhūrmā te saṅgo’stvakarmaṇi

state.translation: Your right is to the action alone, never to its fruits. Do not let the fruit of action be your motive, and do not cling to inaction.

show: Your right is to the action alone, never to its fruits. Do not let the fruit of action be your motive, and do not cling to inaction.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् । स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः ॥ ३-३५॥
verse.iast: śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt | svadharme nidhanaṃ śreyaḥ paradharmo bhayāvahaḥ

state.translation: Better your own dharma, even done imperfectly, than another's dharma done well. Better to die in your own dharma; another's dharma is full of fear.

show: Better your own dharma, even done imperfectly, than another's dharma done well. Better to die in your own dharma; another's dharma is full of fear.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत । अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥ ४-७॥
verse.iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata | abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham

state.translation: Whenever dharma declines, O Bharata, and adharma rises, then I bring myself forth.

show: Whenever dharma declines, O Bharata, and adharma rises, then I bring myself forth.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् । धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे ॥ ४-८॥
verse.iast: paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām | dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge

state.translation: To protect the good, to destroy wrongdoing, and to establish dharma, I come into being, age after age.

show: To protect the good, to destroy wrongdoing, and to establish dharma, I come into being, age after age.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः । लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥ ५-१०॥
verse.iast: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ | lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā

state.translation: One who acts, offering every action to Brahman and giving up attachment, is not stained by sin, as a lotus leaf is not wetted by water.

show: One who acts, offering every action to Brahman and giving up attachment, is not stained by sin, as a lotus leaf is not wetted by water.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् । आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥ ६-५॥
verse.iast: uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet | ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ

state.translation: Lift yourself up by yourself; do not let yourself sink. For the self alone is the friend of the self, and the self alone is its enemy.

show: Lift yourself up by yourself; do not let yourself sink. For the self alone is the friend of the self, and the self alone is its enemy.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय । मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥ ७-७॥
verse.iast: mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya | mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva

state.translation: There is nothing higher than me, Dhananjaya. All this is strung on me, like gems on a thread.

show: There is nothing higher than me, Dhananjaya. All this is strung on me, like gems on a thread.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च । मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयः ॥ ८-७॥
verse.iast: tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca | mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayaḥ

state.translation: Therefore, at all times, remember me, and fight. With your mind and intellect offered to me, you will surely come to me.

show: Therefore, at all times, remember me, and fight. With your mind and intellect offered to me, you will surely come to me.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति । तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥ ९-२६॥
verse.iast: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati | tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ

state.translation: Whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit or water, that offering of love from a pure heart, I partake of.

show: Whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit or water, that offering of love from a pure heart, I partake of.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा । तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥ १०-४१॥
verse.iast: yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā | tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejo’ṃśasambhavam

state.translation: Whatever is glorious, beautiful or mighty, know that it springs from a spark of my splendour.

show: Whatever is glorious, beautiful or mighty, know that it springs from a spark of my splendour.

verse.speaker: Sanjaya
verse.devanagari: दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता । यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥ ११-१२॥
verse.iast: divi sūryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthitā | yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ

state.translation: If the light of a thousand suns were to blaze forth in the sky at once, it might resemble the splendour of that great being.

show: If the light of a thousand suns were to blaze forth in the sky at once, it might resemble the splendour of that great being.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः । ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ॥ ११-३२॥
verse.iast: kālo’smi lokakṣayakṛtpravṛddho lokānsamāhartumiha pravṛttaḥ | ṛte’pi tvāṃ na bhaviṣyanti sarve ye’vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ

state.translation: I am Time, grown mighty, the destroyer of worlds, come forth to consume the worlds. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the opposing armies will remain.

show: I am Time, grown mighty, the destroyer of worlds, come forth to consume the worlds. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the opposing armies will remain.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥ १२-१३॥
verse.iast: adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca | nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣamī

state.translation: One who hates no being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from 'mine' and from ego, the same in pain and pleasure, forgiving ...

show: One who hates no being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from 'mine' and from ego, the same in pain and pleasure, forgiving ...

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते । एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥ १३-२॥
verse.iast: idaṃ śarīraṃ kaunteya kṣetramityabhidhīyate | etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ

state.translation: This body, Kaunteya, is called the field. The one who knows it, those who know call the knower of the field.

show: This body, Kaunteya, is called the field. The one who knows it, those who know call the knower of the field.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः । निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ॥ १४-५॥
verse.iast: sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisambhavāḥ | nibadhnanti mahābāho dehe dehinamavyayam

state.translation: Sattva, rajas and tamas, the gunas born of nature, bind the imperishable embodied self to the body, mighty-armed one.

show: Sattva, rajas and tamas, the gunas born of nature, bind the imperishable embodied self to the body, mighty-armed one.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् । छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ॥ १५-१॥
verse.iast: ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayam | chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit

state.translation: They speak of an imperishable sacred fig, its roots above and its branches below. Its leaves are the Vedic hymns. Whoever knows it knows the Vedas.

show: They speak of an imperishable sacred fig, its roots above and its branches below. Its leaves are the Vedic hymns. Whoever knows it knows the Vedas.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः । कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् ॥ १६-२१॥
verse.iast: trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥ | kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet

state.translation: Threefold is this gate of hell, the ruin of the self: desire, anger and greed. Therefore, give up these three.

show: Threefold is this gate of hell, the ruin of the self: desire, anger and greed. Therefore, give up these three.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत । श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः ॥ १७-३॥
verse.iast: sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata | śraddhāmayo’yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ

state.translation: Each person's faith follows their nature, Bharata. A person is made of faith: whatever one's faith is, that one is.

show: Each person's faith follows their nature, Bharata. A person is made of faith: whatever one's faith is, that one is.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया । विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥ १८-६३॥
verse.iast: iti te jñānamākhyātaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ mayā | vimṛśyaitadaśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru

state.translation: Thus I have told you wisdom more secret than all secrets. Reflect on it fully, then do as you wish.

show: Thus I have told you wisdom more secret than all secrets. Reflect on it fully, then do as you wish.

verse.speaker: Krishna
verse.devanagari: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज । अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥ १८-६६॥
verse.iast: sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja | ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ

state.translation: Giving up all dharmas, take refuge in me alone. I will free you from all sins. Do not grieve.

show: Giving up all dharmas, take refuge in me alone. I will free you from all sins. Do not grieve.

verse.speaker: Arjuna
verse.devanagari: नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत । स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥ १८-७३॥
verse.iast: naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtirlabdhā tvatprasādānmayācyuta | sthito’smi gatasandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava

state.translation: My delusion is gone. By your grace, Achyuta, I have regained my memory. I stand firm, my doubts are gone. I will do as you say.

show: My delusion is gone. By your grace, Achyuta, I have regained my memory. I stand firm, my doubts are gone. I will do as you say.

verse.speaker: Sanjaya
verse.devanagari: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः । तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥ १८-७८॥
verse.iast: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ | tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama

state.translation: Wherever there is Krishna, the lord of yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna, the archer, there are fortune, victory, prosperity and sure justice. That is my conviction.

show: Wherever there is Krishna, the lord of yoga, and wherever there is Arjuna, the archer, there are fortune, victory, prosperity and sure justice. That is my conviction.

verse.speaker: Sanjaya
verse.devanagari: पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनञ्जयः । पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः ॥ १-१५॥
verse.iast: pāñcajanyaṃ hṛṣīkeśo devadattaṃ dhanañjayaḥ | pauṇḍraṃ dadhmau mahāśaṅkhaṃ bhīmakarmā vṛkodaraḥ

show: pāñcajanya = Krishna's conch (1.15)

verse.speaker: Sanjaya
verse.devanagari: तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितॄनथ पितामहान् । आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातॄन्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा ॥ १-२६॥
verse.iast: tatrāpaśyatsthitānpārthaḥ pitṝnatha pitāmahān | ācāryānmātulānbhrātṝnputrānpautrānsakhīṃstathā

verse.devanagari: कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसम्मूढचेताः । यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्चितं ब्रूहि तन्मे शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् ॥ २-७॥
